title: FiestaBoard UX Tree
description: Manifest of user-reachable UX states. Shared source of truth for /map-ux, /audit-ux-coverage, /stub-ux-tests, /fill-ux-tests.

scope.description: Area covered by this manifest. Examples: 'pages', 'integrations', 'schedule', 'all'.

route.description: Next.js route path. Use Next-style brackets for dynamic segments. Example: '/pages/edit/[id]'.

preconditions.description: Setup steps required to reach this state. Examples: 'auth:configured', 'pages:none', 'editor:dirty', 'plugin:installed=weather'.

description.description: Plain-English description of what the user sees / can do in this state.

interactions.description: User actions exposed from this state. Examples: 'click:new-page', 'submit:import-form', 'keyboard:esc'.

transitions_to.description: IDs of nodes reachable from this one via the listed interactions.

source_refs.description: Component / route file paths backing this state. Used by auditor to cross-reference.

i18n_sensitive.description: True when the state contains localized strings that should be spot-checked in a non-English locale.
